remarks: Desirable Home in the Valencia Creekside Community! From the moment you arrive, you’ll appreciate the inviting large front porch of this. An ideal spot to relax and enjoy your morning coffee. As you enter this Upgraded Light  &  Bright Home you are drawn to the Beautiful Wood Flooring with the open floor plan. This Home Boasts 4 Bedrooms (one downstairs), Large Loft, 3 Bathrooms (one downstairs), Approx. 2,200 Sq. Ft. Large Great Room with Romantic Fireplace, Dining Area with New Chandelier and Sliding Door leading to the Private Patio Area. Great for Family Gatherings or Entertaining. Large Kitchen with Walk-In Pantry, Lots of Counter Space and Breakfast Bar. Perfect for any chef
